task.title: Review and merge a draft pull request
task.shortdesc: Answer the draft's questions, edit what the prose needs, and merge when every status passes. can't merge for you.

step.cmd: Read the report in the pull request description.

info.p: Questions lists every open draft comment, with who should answer it.

step.cmd: Get the answer to each engineer question, then edit the topic in drafts/<generation>/topics/.
For each question you have answered, delete its draft-comment or set disposition="closed".
Edit the prose as you would any topic, and push to the pull request branch.

info.p: The gates workflow runs the grammar, the rules and the open-questions check again on every push.

step.cmd: When every status passes, mark the pull request ready for review and merge it.

info.p: The merge is recorded with its count of open questions, which feeds the scorecard.
